ops:
a template replaces the requirements block, add your own instruction when pi must change files:

```yaml
- uses: cv/pi-action@v2
  with:
    github_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
    prompt_template: |
      # {{type_display}} #{{number}}: {{title}}

      {{body}}

      ## Task
      {{task}}

      ## Requirements
      The runner is deleted after this run. Commit and push all changes before you finish.
```

## Troubleshooting

| Problem | Cause and solution |
|---------|--------------------|
| A variable is not replaced | The name is not correct. Names are case-sensitive:
